Ruling-pointer · objectstack-ai/objectstack#24378 re-ruled A at 6258883445 (batch #368 item 1, the maintainer's 「24378 同意 A」; supersedes B′) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-19T03:20Z

For this card's scope: declared rules are read-only in Setup → Sharing Rules, with two actions — Disable (a `sys_metadata_activation` row of type `sharing_rule`, deployment-level, operator-gated under a wall) and Clone (a new stored rule under a new name). No in-place edit of a declared rule; a stored rule may not take a declared rule's name (the platform refuses it, 409). The platform side lands first (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24421's rework of PR #24428); this card stays `pm:blocked` on it.

status: done-locally — pushed `claude/issue-12982-setup-sharing-regime-c` @ `2d5fa96`; the PR-create and report-post strokes were refused by the harness (`gh` token invalid; no MCP write tool), so the PR body and this report are handed to the seat
pr: not opened (body handed to the seat; draft, base main, first line `Part of #12982`) — seat note: opened as #13050
summary: Shape B. The declared sharing rules are the environment scope of the `sharing_rule` registry type (`/apps/setup/metadata/sharing_rule?scope=environment`). They are listed read-only with their package, carry a ledger-backed Disable / Enable switch through `POST /security/_activation/sharing_rule/:name`, and offer Clone. Clone pre-fills a new-named organization rule from the server's one-rule projection, writes it through the `sys_sharing_rule` data door, shows the server's 409 verbatim, then offers to switch the base off. Organization rules stay on the editable `sys_sharing_rule` view, whose New already shows the 409. Every Acceptance line passed in a browser against a showcase on objectstack `main` (`5b14b7f`), except reachability from the Setup nav, which is a server gap.
shape_choice: B. `GET /sharing/rules` filters out declared rules the ledger switches off (measured: after a switch-off the list drops the rule, and `GET /sharing/rules/:name` answers 404), so shape A could never offer Enable; it also has no search, sort or paging. `GET /meta/sharing_rule` lists every declaration with `_packageId`, and never a stored row. The C9 catalog page and its ledger switch are reused as they are.
server_gaps:
  - Setup nav: plugin-sharing's `nav_sharing_rules` points only at `sys_sharing_rule`. The declared page `/apps/setup/metadata/sharing_rule?scope=environment` needs its own Setup nav entry (a `type: 'url'` entry, as `nav_permission_sets` has). It is the one Acceptance gap.
  - No single read answers "declared, and is it switched off" per row. Per row, `GET /meta/sharing_rule` answers "declared", and the switch state comes from `GET /data/sys_metadata_activation`, the same ledger read the C9 catalog makes; it is a state keyed by name, not a second list. A meta item's own `active` is the declaration's authored field: it read `true` for a rule the ledger had switched off, and the detail page shows it as "Active". The server could put the ledger's reading on each `/meta/sharing_rule` item.
  - `GET /sharing/rules/:name` serves no projection of a switched-off declared rule (404), so its clone cannot copy the compiled criteria. The console falls back to the pre-filled New form, which asks for them.
  - `/meta/types` serves `sharing_rule` with `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, and `PUT /meta/sharing_rule/:name` saved an environment-wide registry item (measured on `probe_meta_rule`: 200, then listed by `/meta/sharing_rule` and served by `/sharing/rules`; deleted afterwards). Under regime C that is a third way to author a rule. The console no longer offers it from Setup, but the door is open.
tests: 3 new files, 21 tests (11 list-page tests with fixtures recorded from the boot, 2 editor, 8 helpers). Related set: 19 files, 160 passed. Ablations: canCreate gate → 1 red, editor gate → 1 red, catalog types → 5 red; restored clean. app-shell type-check: 30 tasks successful. ESLint on changed files: 0 errors. Changeset `setup-declared-sharing-rules-12982.md` (app-shell minor). Docs: app-shell README and console-architecture guide.
open_questions:
  - Clone is a dialog that writes the copy, then offers the switch-off, rather than only navigating to the New form; this is the only way the page can make the offer after the copy exists. When the base is already off, Clone does open the pre-filled New form.
  - The switch keeps C9's client gate: a caller without `manage_metadata` sees it disabled with a reason, not the server's refusal. A walled tenant holding the capability is not pre-gated, since `sharing_rule` is not a security catalog type, so it gets the door's own refusal as the card asks.
  - The suggested clone name avoids declared names only. If `<name>_copy` already exists as an organization rule, the data door's UNIQUE_VIOLATION is shown.
  - I read ruling A (6258883445) and the #24421 Landed record (6260568838) through the card's quotation and PR #24428's merged commit message. This session's GitHub API scope does not cover objectstack-ai/objectstack.
out_of_scope_findings:
  - The `sys_sharing_rule` New form needs criteria entered as JSON or through the filter builder; it cannot take a CEL condition.
  - The metadata detail page of a declared rule shows both the server's generic "locked" banner and the new declared-rule hint.
